description: This file defines the BomComponent class which encapsulates a BOM component identified by a reference string. It includes a constructor, a getter for the reference, and overrides the toString method.

classes.name: BomComponent
classes.description: Represents a BOM component with a reference string.

methods.name: BomComponent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the reference field.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Returns the reference string of the BOM component.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the reference string as the string representation of the object.
